title: Homogeneity of the Shapley value
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f$ be a real-valued function on the subsets of an $n$-element set, let $i$ be an element of that set, and let $c\in\mathbb R$. The Shapley value of the game obtained by multiplying $f$ by $c$ is $c$ times the Shapley value of $f$ at $i$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on subsets of an $n$-element set
$i$ is an element of the $n$-element set
